headerDisplay: Exposes Dreame robot vacuums as Matter robotic vacuum cleaners, over the local miIO/MIoT protocol. **Matter must be enabled for the bridge this plugin runs on** — HomeKit has no robot vacuum service, so the vacuum is only reachable through Matter. Each vacuum is commissioned as its own Matter device, with its own QR code, because Apple Home refuses to bridge a robot vacuum.
footerDisplay: The IP address and token are read from the robot once and used on the LAN only — no Xiaomi cloud session is involved. Extract the token with [Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor](https://github.com/PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor); the robot must be paired in the **Xiaomi Home** app. Reconfiguring the robot's Wi-Fi generates a new token.
